capacity_action: raise explicit capacity error, no truncation
insufficient_samples: explicit unavailable if fewer than dictionary size
neighborhood: weak one-hop induced subgraph retaining directed edges and center
partition: seeded permutation chunks; min(32,chunk size) medoids each; recursively cluster medoids to 32
representative: medoid minimizing within-cluster sum distance; ties sample index
sampling: without replacement over (training week,center); equal initial mass per candidate; after selection halve weights of remaining centers inside sampled neighborhood in that week
training_scope: only graph snapshots fully available inside training interval
